ios.desc:
The Periscope HD turns your spare iPhone or iPad into a fully functional wireless IP camera. Watch your home, kids, and pets for free.

No configuration is necessary when using the Periscope Pro. You can search the Mac App Store for "Periscope Pro" or enter bit.ly/periscope_pro into your Mac Browser.

To use Periscope HD without Periscope Pro, check the "Preferences" tab for RTSP URL. Then put it in your favorite RTSP-enabled video player/IP camera viewer. It should work, but we didn't test it.

Technical specifications: 
Video: H.264, 1280x720, 30 fps; 
Audio: G.711 PCMU 8000 Hz; 
Networking: RTSP over UDP, RTSP over TCP; Bonjour.

quotes.text:
I use an old iPad with brightness turned way down as an indoor IP security camera via the free Periscope HD app:

https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/periscope-hd-h-264-rtsp-cam/id1095600218

I also use an old iPhone mounted inside the front door as a Touch ID enabled alarm control panel for a DIY HomeKit alarm system. This is using a Homebridge plugin I wrote:

https://github.com/vectronic/homebridge-alarm-panel
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: What are some interesting projects to reuse your old devices?
